title: dev.qory.run.policy_applied
description: The policy the run is pinned to, as read before the runtime started, with where it came from. Emitted once at the start, and again at the sequence where a new run configuration from the server took effect.

allow.description: The allow list in force: the policy's entries. The hosts the harness declared do not narrow it.

deny.description: The deny list in force: the policy's entries, each denied by name in either mode. Absent means an empty list.

source.description: config when a policy document was given to the runner; fetched when the policy is the security_policy of a run configuration the server answered; none when there was neither and the runner observes everything.

url.description: The URL the run configuration was fetched from, without its query, when source is fetched.

digest.description: sha256 of the policy document as canonical JSON, hex, when source is config or fetched: the version stamp of the run's policy, the same for the same policy however it was written. The runner's own.

run_configuration.description: The server's digest of the run configuration document, as its X-Qory-Run-Configuration header carried it, when source is fetched. The server's own and opaque: the runner never recomputes it.

paths.description: The policy's path rules, by host, when it has any.

credentials.description: The credentials the run holds outside the enclosure, as resolved before the runtime started: where each goes and how. Never a token.

tools.description: The tools the run reaches, started before the runtime: each one's name and the hosts it serves. Fixed for the run: a later policy_applied repeats them. Added in revision 2.

terminated.description: The hosts the proxy terminates TLS for in this run: the ones a credential is for, the ones a tool serves and the ones with path rules. Every other host is a tunnel the proxy does not read.

harness_hosts.description: The egress the harness declared, as handed to the runner, when it was. Information only: it decides nothing.
